description: A metaphor (the cave) whose surface content is concrete but whose intended reading is symbolic.
quoteText: And now, I said, let me show in a figure how far our nature is enlightened or unenlightened: Behold! human beings living in an underground den, who have been there from their childhood, and have their legs and necks chained so that they cannot move, and can only see before them, being prevented by the chains from turning round their heads.
